nodes.label: Add a word from /lesson-items — and the words entity it implies
nodes.rationale: Introduced a real words table (many-to-many via lesson_items) instead of relaxing lesson_items.lesson_id to nullable: a word with no lesson is the natural base case of a real entity (lesson_count=0 falls out of a left join), not a special case to permit. lesson_item_attrs folded into words because every one of its sparse/no-FK properties was a workaround for the absence of a word entity.

nodes.label: Add word on lesson items page (doc, referenced)
nodes.rationale: Establishes that norm_key identity belongs to Postgres, which R3's word-key extraction must not obscure.
